analyst.text: Memphis had their franchise-record eight-game road winning streak snapped 104-95 in Minnesota on Saturday and are still without rookie Cameron Boozer (ankle), though Ty Jerome is back and scored 18. Charlotte have lost 10 of 11 and come home from an 0-4 road trip; Moussa Diabate, in a contract year, is rebounding well and says the team needs urgency. Memphis come in rested and stung by the loss, so the angle leans Memphis.
